title: Samsung SF2 gate-all-around node
summary: Samsung's 2nm-class process, the first commercial gate-all-around node.
bodyHtml:
What This Is

Samsung introduced gate-all-around transistors at 3nm and is scaling the approach at SF2, aiming to win foundry customers who want a second source to TSMC. Gate-all-around improves electrostatic control at small dimensions but demands new integration steps and defect control. Samsung's challenge has been yield and customer confidence rather than the underlying device architecture.

Status

Attribute Value
Development stage Early commercial
Estimated window 2025–2027
Confidence label Researching
Evidence Editorial synthesis of company, agency and press reporting
Compiled 18 November 2026

Related records

Investment Exposure

A credible second source changes pricing power in leading-edge foundry, even if it never matches the leader's yield.

What Would Change The View

  • Customer tape-outs and yield data.
  • Exynos and external customer mix.
  • Packaging integration with HBM.

Record Notes

Editorial brief, not an imported source note. Named milestones are drawn from company, agency and press reporting; forward dates are announced targets, not verified outcomes. No figure here is an audited statistic.
